rows.note: Use 睇 as the all-purpose spoken verb for looking at or watching something.

example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 tai2 mong5 soeng6 di1 pin2

rows.note: Use this construction when regarding A as B, rather than simply looking at A.

example.english: I view him as one of my own.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dong1 keoi5 hai6 zi6 gei2 jan4

rows.note: Use this for scenery or an outlook, especially what can be seen from a place.

example.english: The view here is really beautiful.
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 ge3 ging2 sik1 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice for an opinion or a personal point of view.

example.english: What’s your view on this matter?
example.jyutping: nei5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 jau5 me1 tai2 faat3

rows.note: Use this for the area or range that someone can see, rather than for scenery or an opinion.

example.english: With these glasses, my field of view is wider.
example.traditional: 戴住呢副眼鏡，我嘅視野闊咗。
example.jyutping: daai3 zyu6 ni1 fu3 ngaan5 geng2 ngo5 ge3 si6 je5 fut3 zo2

rows.note: Use this for the number of times an online video or other digital item has been viewed.

example.english: Once the video went online, its view count passed ten thousand.
example.traditional: 條片一出街，觀看次數就過萬。
example.jyutping: tiu4 pin2 jat1 ceot1 gaai1 gun1 hon3 ci3 sou3 zau6 gwo3 maan6
